summary: Multiplies a 3x3 matrix stored as 9 doubles (row-major, offsets this+0x0 through this+0x40) by a 3-element vector a2 and writes the product into a3. Row 0 sums this[0]*a2[0] + this[1]*a2[1] + this[2]*a2[2], row 1 uses this[3]/this[4]/this[5], row 2 uses this[6]/this[7]/this[8]. Returns the input vector pointer a2. Pure coordinate-transform helper with no branches, globals, or callees; used by physics solvers (RigidBodyConstraintJointSolver, WheelContactForceSolver, VehiclePhysicsInitializer).

operations.description: Set result = a2 (the return value is the input vector pointer).
a3[0] = this[0]*a2[0] + this[1]*a2[1] + this[2]*a2[2] (matrix row 0, offsets +0x0/+0x8/+0x10).
a3[1] = this[3]*a2[0] + this[4]*a2[1] + this[5]*a2[2] (matrix row 1, offsets +0x18/+0x20/+0x28).
a3[2] = this[6]*a2[0] + this[7]*a2[1] + this[8]*a2[2] (matrix row 2, offsets +0x30/+0x38/+0x40).
Return result (the input vector pointer a2).
